description: Compose a template and selected modules into a checked app contract and lockfile plan without writing files. Use this to preview the exact app composition before generate_project or deployment planning.

config.description: Template configuration overrides for generated source, runtime bindings, or module-specific settings.

modules.description: Optional microservices.sh module ids to include, such as auth, booking, customer, payment, files, or audit-log.

templateId.description: Template id to use for app composition. Omit to use the registry default template.

name: compose_app
title: Compose App
